title: Council approves library modem lines - The Daily Packet

blocks.text: Council approves modem lines for the library

content.text: By our city hall reporter | December 8, 1995
The city council voted 5 to 2 on Tuesday to pay for four telephone lines at the public library, so that residents without a computer can try the Internet at a public terminal.
"Students at Northstar already have this," said councilwoman Ana Ruiz. "Everyone else in town should too." The terminals are expected by spring.
